payload.title: Inconsistent framework labels and noisy third parties in scan results
payload.description: Found on a design partner's Next.js app with CLI 0.0.26. Placeholder hosts (example.com, .test, .invalid) were reported as third parties, Notion was counted twice (notion.so and notion.com), underscore names such as Google_identity were not split, and Next.js appeared under several spellings. Jira: [DATAP-772](https://anthus.atlassian.net/browse/DATAP-772).
